5170-6132-8095-8175.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Edgar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Edgar trigger.
Resolve the Edgar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Repeat.

1563-2457-3000-8201.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

710-3055-3899.notablePrerequisites: Gift of Immortality attached to Danitha.
710-3055-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Danitha
When Danitha dies, Gift of Immortality triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Gift of Immortality from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

3480-3755-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
3480-3755-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
3480-3755-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-3259-3986.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control creatures with total power 6 or greater that can attack this combat.
1115-3259-3986.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Battle Cry Goblin as attackers. If needed, declare more creatures as attackers to ensure that the total power of attacking creatures is 6 or greater.
Battle Cry Goblin triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-6096-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6096-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and General Kreat as attackers.
General Kreat triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, General Kreat triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-6096-7060.notes: After the first loop, General Kreat doesn't have to attack, since the Goblin token attacking will trigger it.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-2044-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

625-1978-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
625-1978-5709.description:
Cause Rofellos to become an artifact using Ashnod's Transmogrant.
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat from step 2.

1315-3234-3293-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
1315-3234-3293-6798.description:
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
1315-3234-3293-6798.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2530-2577-6518-6823.easyPrerequisites: You control another Zombie if Gravecrawler is in your graveyard.
2530-2577-6518-6823.description:
Cast Gravecrawler either from your hand or graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Aunt May, Carnival of Souls and The Sibsig Ceremony trigger.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Resolve the Sibsig Ceremony trigger, destroying Gravecrawler and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When the Zombie Druid enters the battlefield, Aunt May and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Aunt May trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and add {B}.
Repeat.

2018-6288-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Demon in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Infernal Vessel.
When Infernal Vessel dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Infernal Vessel from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1741-4222-5921-5970-6120.easyPrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Marina.
1741-4222-5921-5970-6120.notablePrerequisites:
You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {U}{U}.
Fractured Realm is unlocked.
1741-4222-5921-5970-6120.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {U}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Bottomless Pool.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Bottomless Pool.
Bottomless Pool triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, choosing not to return anything to your hand.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3259-4359-5484.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander is on the battlefield.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature that isn't your commander.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-4359-5484.description:
Declare your commander and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
We Ride at Dawn's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Mercenary creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Mercenary token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

575-4319-5256-5441.notablePrerequisites: Skirk Alarmist does not have summoning sickness.
575-4319-5256-5441.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Granite Witness.
When Granite Witness dies, Yedora triggers, returning Granite Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Granite Witness's power.
Activate Granite Witness by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Skirk Alarmist by tapping it, turning Granite Witness face-up.
Granite Witness triggers, untapping Skirk Alarmist.
Repeat.

272-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Stangg, adding {C}{C}.
When Stangg dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Stangg from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Stangg enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 3/4 Stangg Twin creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Stangg Twin, adding {C}{C}.
When the Stangg Twin token dies, Stangg triggers.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1.

624-4605-4681.description:
Cast Karmic Guide by paying {3}{W}{W}.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Phantasmal Image to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Choose not to have Phantasmal Image copy anything as it enters the battlefield.
Phantasmal Image dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Preston triggers, creating a copy of Phantasmal Image that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Choose to have the Phantasmal Image token enter the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When the Phantasmal Image token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Phantasmal Image to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

513-2739-3923-4668.notablePrerequisites:
the Warped Eclipse.
Your opponents have drawn at least two cards this turn.
513-2739-3923-4668.description:
Activate Arcane Signet by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Mystic Speculation with buyback by paying {U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Arcane Signet to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Mystic Speculation, causing you to scry 3 and returning Mystic Speculation to your hand.
Cast Arcane Signet by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1117-2438-3451-4766.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature card in your graveyard with mana value four or greater.
1117-2438-3451-4766.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Junk Diver.
When Junk Diver dies, it, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Junk Diver trigger, returning an artifact creature card with mana value four or greater from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting the artifact creature with mana value four or greater from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return a creature card with mana value two or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with Deathrender attached.
When the creature dies, Deathrender and Death's Oasis triggers.
Resolve the Death's Oasis trigger, causing you to mill two cards and return Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Junk Diver from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities from steps 1 and 6, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

2719-4364-4702.description:
During your combat phase, activate the nontoken Aurelia by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself.
Declare the token Aurelia as an attacker.
The token Aurelia triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

317-2034-3192.notablePrerequisites: Ulasht has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
317-2034-3192.description:
Activate Ulasht by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {C}{C}.
Mazirek triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.

2649-3542-4615-4893.description:
Cast Palinchron.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, you can untap 7 lands.
untap lands to produce {2}{U}{U}{W/U}{R}{R}.
Cast Vadrok, Apex of Thunder for its mutate cost under Palinchron.
When Vadrok, Apex of Thunder successfully mutates you can cast Quasiduplicate from your graveyard for free.
Cast Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to make a token copy of Palinchron.
When the token copy of Palinchron enters the battlefield in response to its ability, return the original Palinchron to your hand with its ability.
Repeat.
